# Lua QR Encoder

`qrencode.lua` is from speedata/luaqrcode, commit
`5a9c34bc04d5113048df8528af72ef31d25b7300`:
https://github.com/speedata/luaqrcode/tree/5a9c34bc04d5113048df8528af72ef31d25b7300

It retains its BSD-3-Clause license in the source header, separately from
Lookout's MIT license. The only adaptation exposes `qrcode` on WoW's addon
namespace before the upstream return statements.
